findings.rationale: Accepted: (h2) now runs the exported integrity helper on a tree whose id.txt carries the git-style ident expansion and asserts `tree integrity: id.txt`, giving the frozen R3 sentence a literal witness while production keeps attributes inert.
Accepted: same repair as the GLM finding — the integrity-helper mutation IS a git-style ident expansion of id.txt and the assertion is `tree integrity: id.txt` with no MANIFEST.json (§2 (h2)).

Accepted and reproduced (a sentinel driver attached via .git/info/attributes ran under the previous design): every tree command now uses an isolated temporary GIT_DIR sharing only the object store via objects/info/alternates, with no config/attributes/hooks and GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL/SYSTEM=/dev/null; probed 2026-09-17 (driver never runs; the real-git-dir control does); fixture (h2b) added (§1.1, §2, §2.6).

Accepted: the diff file is first proven byte-canonical against a regeneration of `git diff --no-ext-diff --no-textconv <base>..<candidate>` from the resolved OIDs (fail closed `diff not canonical`), so positional alignment with --name-status is sound; equal-count swapped-section fixture (h2c) added (§1.1, §2, §6).
